methods.gate: Gate at the prior close for the arrival of each marked return. Gate subsets use trading-session annualization.
methods.gross: Same fills and quantities. Restore their charged fees and adverse execution slippage in that day's return.
methods.turnover: One half of absolute traded opening notional divided by preceding marked equity.
methods.verdict: All scheduled windows must complete. At least seven must beat the benchmark, aggregate CAGR must exceed the benchmark, and drawdown cannot exceed 1.2 times benchmark drawdown.
